Item Description: A 4.0oz tube of █████™ sour ooze candy, labelled as being blue raspberry flavored. When the contents of the tube come into contact with human saliva, the consumer's skin pigmentation will rapidly adopt a dark blue color17 over approximately 1.25 seconds following consumption. Treatment for affected individuals is currently limited to cosmetic surgery, as there are (as of March 23rd, 2026) no known ways to reverse the changes to the skin's pigmentation.
Date of Recovery: September 8th, 2025
Location of Recovery: ███████ Family Residence, ███████, North Carolina.
Current Status: Stored within Site-██ low-risk storage.

Item Description: Blue cotton vest, similar to those marketed for fishing purposes, with several pockets. When worn by a human subject, and the subject begins to pat the pockets in an attempt to find a specific item, a small but useful item will be found in one of the pockets. Any object produced in this way is not necessarily what the subject wanted at the moment, but is typically useful in the current situation. Objects produced are non-anomalous and can be used as normal. When not used in this fashion, the pockets contain only what was left in them most recently (which should be nothing, outside of testing situations).
Date of Recovery: June 8th, 2026
Location of Recovery: Discovered in the lost and found box at a public park in [REDACTED], following online rumors of a magical fishing vest.
Current Status: Being tested; proposals for testing with potential Anomalous Items or SCP-level objects is under review.

Item Description: A paperback scientific work of literature containing 1120 pages, labelled on the front cover as "The Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Normalities Fifth Edition," abbreviated to "DSMN-5" in the subtitle. Anomalous effects manifest when the book is read by a conscious individual literate in the English language whom has been diagnosed with any mental disorder described in the non-anomalous DSM-518. Upon the last utterance of a paragraph's contents describing the subject's mental affliction, they will find the effects of their disorder no longer active. Extended evaluations and observation conducted by foundation psychiatrists and therapists have revealed that this "cure" is ineffective, with an extended tendency for self harm and suicidal behavior observed among patients within as little as 30 days after exposure.
Date of Recovery: June 10th, 2017
Location of Recovery: Office B7, The Waites-Bathory Insitute for the Mentally Disturbed, Massachusetts, United States of America.
Current Status: In possession of Site-██'s senior psychiatrist, Dr. Wittenberg Transferred to low-risk storage following the events of March 23rd, 2026.

Item Description: Transparent plastic rain cape. No information regarding the manufacturer is visible as the tag has been removed. When worn by a human subject during a period of rain, the wearer of the cape becomes unable to be consciously noticed by others unless his or her presence is pointed out, but others will unconsciously avoid running into the individual. Any actions taken by the subject in question are explained as mere coincidence.
Date of Recovery: June 17th, 2026
Location of Recovery: In a lost and found bin at [REDACTED] High School, Providence, RI
Current Status: Undergoing testing.

Item Description: A wooden shepherd's crook measuring 1.55 meters, with its hook able to broaden and shrink when in contact with a sentient subject. When an individual or animal is ensnared either by the neck or leg via the hook, they become unable to escape until released by the handler.
Date of Recovery: 6/4/2026
Location of Recovery: County Clare, Ireland.
Current Status: Stored within a standard containment locker.

Item Description: A dagger from the Mycenaean era of Greece. Skin contact with its blade causes temporary paralysis in human beings.19
Date of Recovery: February 3rd, 1884
Location of Recovery: Lyon, France. Traded to the Estate Noir20 by the private collector Percival Darke as part of a larger exchange.
Current Status: Held in Site-17's anomalous item storage vault.

Anomalous Items 1611 - 1620

Item Description: A domestic cow with a pale yellow hide and a keratinous growth on its head resembling a Santa hat. Instead of milk, object produces eggnog from its udders.
Date of Recovery: December 8th, 2008
Location of Recovery: A field in Kentucky, first sighted by a local hiker.
Current Status: Held in a low security containment cell at Site-19

Item Description: An ongoing phenomena surrounding the account "ShadowFan52" on the website "ROMHackBus.org", an internet forum. The account documents an elaborate personal life and regularly interacts with other users, however there is no other evidence of the individual existing. Research indicates that the activity of the account is created by a chain of highly unlikely events21 that not only happen at abnormal frequency but consistently cause data corruption that manifests as coherent posts the software can render. This occurs regardless of where the server for "ROMHackBus.org" is stored.
Date of Recovery: June 2nd, 2004.
Location of Recovery: A server farm in California.
Current Status: "ROMHackBus.org" at the time of writing only has fifteen remaining non-anomalous users, and the owner of the platform has expressed losing interest in continuing to operate and pay for the website. Site-15 has assembled protocols to continue to host to preserve the anomaly and use Foundation staff to interact with the account so it does not experience mental deterioration from isolation, assuming that there is an actual intelligence responsible for the activity and it is not simply random chance.

Item Description: A yellow padlock, which makes any human subject that makes physical contact with it believe that the Sun will explode in the following 10 seconds. Anomalous effects disappear after subject realizes the Sun didn't explode.
Date of Recovery: March 12th, 2025
Location of Recovery: ███████ Gym, Kalasin, Kalasin province, Thailand
Current Status: In storage

Item Description: A 6 made of white plastic. Despite lacking any identifiable marks, any subject exposed to it will correctly identify it as a 6 instead of a 9 even when presented upside down.
Date of Recovery: October 7th, 1995
Location of Recovery: ███████ School, Independència, Guairá Department, Paraguay.
Current Status: In storage.

Item Description: A standard, unbranded cardboard tissue box that contains an infinite supply of non-anomalous wood-pulp tissues. X-ray scans of the interior show a distorted spatial region.
Date of Recovery: ██/██/20██
Location of Recovery:An aged care facility in Oregon.
Current Status: Kept tethered in the Staff Breakroom at Site-██.

Item Description: A wooden door painted pink. Following its opening, a male instance of Velociraptor mongoliensis will manifest on the other side of the door before vocalizing in English, "Do you mind? We're very busy," closing the door and demanifesting. Attempts to stop this set of events have consistently failed.
Date of Recovery: June 12th, 1993
Location of Recovery: Middle of a steppe in Southern Mongolia.
Current Status: In possession of the Department of Paleontology for research purposes.

Item Description: A worn mahogany bureau that is consistent with early 19th century manufacture. When an individual attempts to write on a piece of paper while at the bureau, a vocalization near the individual will offer advice for any subject matter the individual is currently thinking. Writing via digital devices yields no anomalous effects.
Date of Recovery: 20/06/1937
Location of Recovery: An antiques shop in London, UK.
Current Status: Kept in low-value storage.

Item Description: A 15 inch tall statuette of a traveling salesman holding two briefcases, with attire consistent with the late 1940s. When viewed by a group of individuals, regardless of whether or not an auction is currently being held, each viewer feels a strong compulsion to place a bid on the item. Subsequent bids increase the price by ██%, and continue until all parties involved can no longer afford to bid. Viewing the item alone or with no currency present results in anomalous effects not manifesting.
Date of Recovery: February 10th, 1999
Location of Recovery: A Marshall, Carter, & Dark auction held at ████ ████, China. Before recovery by MTF Mu-3, the item's final price reached approximately ¥██,███,███.██ over its original value of ¥2,030.
Current Status: In storage. A sign is posted near the item's containment locker prohibiting any form of currency in the area.

Item Description: A glass marble, visually identical to commercially available varieties. Appears non-anomalous until viewed by a human subject, at which point the subject will become convinced that the item is capable of moving on its own, and has done so when the item was unobserved. Pointing out that the item is still in its original position will have no effect, as this will be rationalized. This effect is relatively weak and fades quickly.
Date of Recovery: July 14th, 2026
Location of Recovery: A thrift store in Maryland
Current Status: In low-value item storage.

Item Description: A bronze and iron mechanism that functions as a perpetual motion machine.
Date of Recovery: July 12th, 2026
Location of Recovery: Basement in Hamamatsu, Japan
Current status: In storage
Notes: Due to the great number of perpetual motion machines discovered by the SCP Foundation, further additions to this log of this nature will be rejected. — Lead Researcher John A. Squires.

Anomalous Items 1621 - 1630

Item Description: An octagonal green street sign labeled "GO" which exhibited cognitohazardous effects on drivers
Date of Recovery: July 24th, 2026
Location of Recovery: Intersection of Shadowwood Dr. and Maple Valley St. in Gun Barrel City, TX.
Current status: In storage
Notes: Casualties: 1 dead, 3 injured. Foundation operatives working with law enforcement have explained the two crashes as the result of faulty accelerator pedal installation by a local auto repair shop.

Item Description: A preserved human thumb wrapped in ancient linen cloth. Physical contact with the object causes feelings of hostility toward minorities and foreigners to develop, as well as a sudden surge in patriotism. All effects vanish once the object is released. DNA testing has been inconclusive.
Date of Recovery: August 21st, 2008
Location of Recovery: Hidden storage space in Poenari Castle, Romania
Current Status: In storage

Item Description: An unidentified object that mimics the appearance, but not the function, of the nearest object. Its real form is currently unknown. It constantly emits small quantities of X-rays.
Date of Recovery: July 8th, 1947
Location of Recovery: Roswell, New Mexico
Current Status: Contained in a lead-lined container.
Notes: Object currently possesses the appearance of a slightly smaller lead-lined container.

Item Description: Two stable, unreactive atoms of flerovium-114, a nuclide consisting entirely of protons
Date of Recovery: September 3rd, 1999
Location of Recovery: Dubna, Russia
Current Status: Contained in an ion trap.
Notes: As of August 9th, 2026, all attempts to repeat synthesis have failed.

Item Description: An Arcadia-brand arcade cabinet of the game ████████. The interior is comprised of a full set of human organs, which are wired to various mechanical components such as the control panel and monitor. Individuals who make physical contact express the sensation of arms wrapping around them after four minutes, followed by the subject being anomalously consumed shortly after.
Date of Recovery: February 29th, 2016
Location of Recovery: A warehouse in Boston, Massachusetts
Current Status: Kept in low-risk item storage. A sign is posted near the item's containment prohibiting any physical contact.

Item Description: A crude rocket launcher comprised of various components from household appliances, including mismatched pipes, a metallic funnel, and a glass bottle. When loaded with any projectile, regardless of whether or not the loaded object is a rocket or has a rocket motor, the inserted item will be propelled at the rate of ███ meters per second when fired.
Date of Recovery: 27/06/2012
Location of Recovery: Recovered after a Chaos Insurgency raid on Site-██
Current Status: Being tested.
Note: Despite its amateurish construction, it's surprisingly durable. Throughout all of our tests, it's managed to perfectly fire anything we load into it, from rockets to miscellaneous items like tennis balls. Further testing is needed to determine how large of an object we can use. - Researcher Doe

Item Description: A shape that always has an N-number of sides, corners, and vertices.22
Date of Recovery: 13/08/2002
Location of Recovery: Site-43
Current Status: Currently within Mathematical Locker 18 of S43.
Note: Attempted interaction of the object by persons within S43 had unpredictable results.

Item Description: A string of 96 numbers that, when entered into an applicable elevator via the buttons to select a floor, will cause the elevator to arrive in an alternate timeline which has no noted deviation from the baseline besides the string discovered in the other universe being a different series of numbers. This string has the reverse effect; allowing individuals from the other timeline to enter the baseline. Neither string has any impact outside of the timeline it was discovered in.
Date of Recovery: July 6th, 1972
Location of Recovery: On a post-it note attached to the outer doors of the Site-██ C-Wing elevator.
Current Status: Written on a post-it note in Dr. Jacob's office and the duplicate of his office in the other timeline.
How in God's name did anybody figure this out? Does anybody have access to the recovery log? - Specialist Daniels

Item Description: A miniature diorama depicting the initial containment of SCP-████ by Foundation operatives, with glass enclosing the model. Every half hour, the model figures inside begin to replicate the exact movements and outcome of the encounter with SCP-████, with only minor deviations every loop. Any damage to the model figures caused during the battle is repaired after the scene finishes, before they return to their original positions shortly after.
Date of Recovery: June 15th, 2015
Location of Recovery: A museum in Stockholm, Sweden.
Current Status: On display in Dr. ███████'s office.

Item Description: A film reel of the 1952 social guidance film Duck and Cover. When an individual over the age of five observes the film to its conclusion, they begin to feel an intense sense of dread regarding nuclear war, leading to a strong compulsion to hide underneath the nearest piece of furniture. This effect typically persists for a period of ten minutes, but can subside earlier if the individual is presented evidence that no nuclear detonation has occurred.
Date of Recovery: September 15th, 2004
Location of Recovery: Inside a container of non-anomalous film reels sold during an auction in Washington, D.C.
Current Status: Kept within low-risk media storage at Site-███.

Anomalous Items 1631 - 1640

Item Description: Wooden door, painted white. Any time a human subject knocks on the door, an unidentified female voice from the other side says "I'll be out in a minute!" This occurs regardless of whether the door is installed in a doorway, whether anyone is on the other side, or who knocks on the door.
Date of Recovery: September 9th, 2026
Location of Recovery: A hardware store in Cincinnati, OH
Current Status: In storage.
Note: The Foundation is currently attempting to identify the voice associated with this item. It does not appear to respond when spoken to, although whether it is unable to do so or simply refusing to is unclear. Researchers assigned to the project say it's "slow going". - Researcher Malkin
Additional Note: Proposals to knock on both sides of the door simultaneously have been and will continue to be rejected. Interesting as it would be to find out what would happen, the risk of paradox should not be ignored. - Dr. ██████████

Item Description: One hammer and one falcon feather. When both objects are dropped simultaneously by the same subject, the hammer will fall anomalously slowly and the feather anomalously quickly. Tests in vacuum environments have failed to produce any anomalous effects.
Date of Recovery: July 21st, 1971
Location of Recovery: John F. Kennedy Space Center, Merritt Island, Florida
Current Status: In storage.

Item Description: A drawing of a map that disproves the Four Color Theorem.23
Date of Recovery: June 22nd, 1976
Location of Recovery: Crumbled in a wastebasket in the University of Illinois
Current Status: Under study by the Department of Anomalous Topology.
Note: I've spent the last three hours staring at this drawing, and I still can't find out where it should fail. - Dr. Cuco

Item Description: A fridge magnet that, when used to hang any printed map upon a magnetic surface, will cause New Zealand to disappear from the map. The country will reappear once the magnet is taken off.
Date of Recovery: May 3rd, 2026
Location of Recovery: A high school classroom in ████████, Australia
Current Status: In storage.
Note: Haha, I get it guys, my country doesn't exist. You can stop showing me maps as "proof". - Dr. Stevenson

Item Description: A copper arrowhead that exerts a strong memetic compulsion effect. If a sapient creature views the object, they will attempt to inflict a mild wound on themselves with it, for the stated purpose of "getting a sit." After the subject wounds themselves, all effects cease, and they develop an immunity to the meme.
Date of Recovery: September 2, 2026
Location of Recovery: The apartment of one Robert Poleman, Agent Sadie Poleman's younger brother.
Current Status: Stored in an opaque tube in Site-19's Safe Containment wing. Available for research by Memetics Department personnel upon request.

Item Description: A lithium-ion battery that sustains a voltage of exactly 7.0375821 volts. It never runs out or changes voltage.
Date of Recovery: September 21, 2026
Location of Recovery: The battery inside of a remote control of one Jason Liu, a civilian with no known connections to the foundation.
Current Status: In storage.

Item Description: 1/2 liter plastic bottle, reminiscent of disposable drink bottles, with remnants of glue and paper indicating that a label was once present but was removed before containment. When the bottle's cap is firmly screwed on and the item is touched by a human subject, liquid of some kind will manifest within the bottle. This is typically a soft drink of some variety, although other liquids have been reported. Liquids produced are rarely (>10% of cases) something the subject would have chosen, but are palatable enough to be consumed regardless.
Date of Recovery: September 20th, 2026
Location of Recovery: Abandoned at Wrigley Field, Chicago, IL
Current Status: Being tested.

Item Description: Small hand mirror, no manufacturer's information visible. When used by a human subject, the subject will see some variety of small, harmless animal sitting on their body. No notable pattern has been discovered, and the animal changes between uses. The animal only appears in the mirror, although some subjects have reported feeling pressure or weight in the relevant area.
Date of Recovery: September 21st, 2026
Location of Recovery: [REDACTED] Middle School, Greer, AL
Current Status: In storage.

Item Description: Full-sized memory foam mattress. When placed in an appropriate bed frame and used by a human subject, the subject suffers a cognitohazardous effect causing them to believe some variety of monster is under the bed. Subjects are either unable or unwilling to describe what form this creature takes, but typically experience significant fear, rendering them unable to fall asleep.
Date of Recovery: September 19th, 2026
Location of Recovery: In the contents of an abandoned storage locker, belonging to an individual with suspected ties to Group of Interest Are We Cool Yet?
Current Status: In storage.

Item Description: Sword made in the style of early 3rd-century BCE Greek weapons. Item displays mild wear and tear, but nothing to indicate it was as old as the design suggests. Analysis of the material indicates that the item cannot have been made earlier than 1980, and with modern techniques. When touched by a human subject, the subject is filled with an unreasoning hatred of Athens and anything related to it. This effect fades very quickly when the object is released.
Date of Recovery: September 20th, 2026
Location of Recovery: Abandoned at a convention center in Rochester, NY
Current Status: Being tested.

Anomalous Items 1641 - 1650

Item Description: A common sunflower (Helianthus annuus), with the disk florets being replaced by a sustained fusion reaction. The reaction radiates no heat and produces minimal light. Every 24 hours a large ember will launch from the object.
Date of Recovery: 5/5/2009
Location of Recovery: Office in Seattle, Washington
Current Status: Break room of Bio Site-7.

Item Description: An Iveco Daily van fitted with a specialised insulated refrigerated box body, formerly owned and branded by Tesco plc. During use to make food deliveries, all items in the van are replaced with similar, yet distinctly different, items. During delivery, the customers are informed via automatic email that their items have been replaced.
Date of Recovery: October 1st, 2019
Location of Recovery: Tesco Superstore, Southampton, Hampshire
Current Status: Kept for delivery usage in Foundation supply chains.

Item Description: 4 dirty sheets of paper, each measuring 21 by 14 centimetres, lightly ripped on the side, theorised to have been ripped out from a journal. On one of the pages is written with permanent marker "Don't forget about me." the rest were found blank Each page appears blank, anything written or drawn on the pages, disappears as soon as the writer dies, any attempt to write or draw on the pages indirectly, fails to leave a mark on the pages regardless of method. Aside from these properties the papers have no notable anomalous traits. At undetermined intervals the phrase "Don't forget about me." appears written on one of the pages, of the two times this phenomenon was recorded, they lasted 3.7 seconds and 1.8 seconds, respectively. There are no other notable phenomenon present during this.
Date of Recovery: November 8rd, 1984
Location of Recovery: Discovered in Police evidence in Greenwood, Delaware.
Current Status: In storage.

Item Description: Paperback copy of The Catcher in the Rye by J.D. Salinger. Subjects who read past the third chapter develop an anomalous compulsion to kill English musician John Lennon and will prioritize doing so. The compulsion ends when the subject hears or sees a statement that John Lennon is already deceased.
Date of Recovery: December 3rd, 2012
Location of Recovery: In a bookstore in Brisbane, Australia.
Current Status: In storage.
Note: The book is not the same copy that was in possession of Mark David Chapman.

Footnotes
1. The Magic 8 Ball was invented in 1946.
2. This dish wand is so powerful that it washes away bad press with its bureaucratohazardous and memetic effects! It can't be described, but rather, must be advertised! Failure to describe it in a positive, bombastic manner is punishable by death, and will result in vaporization by the wand's self-defense mode, which is powerful enough to also melt away any offending recorded materials!
3. Using any other dish soap triggers the self-defense mode, vaporizing the user instantly!
4. Even living creatures, which have all the moisture taken from their bodies in ten seconds!
5. The wand can reach temperatures up to 52 million ⁰C!
6. Agfordtage Co. is not responsible for any injury or death caused by misuse of the Magic Wand.
7. Attempts at conventional containment procedures were deemed to portray the Magic Wand in a negative
8. A member of Site-19 staff with Level 3 Clearance, with approval from at least one Lead Researcher from Site-19's Anomalous Items Department.
9. Effect applies to standard six or twelve-string guitars.
10. (1)
\begin{align} \frac{1 + \sqrt{5}}{2} \end{align}
11. It was Pizza Day at Site-██ at the time.
12. A seemingly exact copy of the anomaly appeared at the same spot on May 21, 2025, though it has the opposite probabilistic effect. This "lucky jersey" is given as a reward to especially loyal researchers and field agents on game night.
13. Junior Researcher ██████ has requested that he remain anonymous.
14. Testing of this point involved an experimental composition in "√2/4", created by Researcher Hira solely for said test.
15. More commonly known as the Australian cockroach.
16. “A little bit louder now (Shout!)”
17. Described as "Navy Blue" by ███████ ███████ during recovery following a call to 911.
18. The Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, Fifth Edition
19. Injury with the blade is not necessary for paralysis to take effect.
20. French precursor organization.
21. Including power surges, bit-flips from solar rays and one instance of an anomalous cyber-criminal trying to use an infohazard to shut off large portions of the internet that was stopped by the Foundation.
22. N = Natural numbers.
23. A theorem that states that no more than four colors are required to color the regions of any map so that no two adjacent regions have the same color.
log-of-anomalous-items-vol-vii.raw_source:

[[module rate]]

[[/>]]

>  **Foreword:** The SCP Foundation has discovered a substantial number of items which are simply too useless to merit further attention. This document lists those items which have prompted some curiosity. It may be used as a resource should knowledge of these items become useful or necessary in the future.  

> – Dr. █████ █████, Head of Research, Site-██



As the most recent volume in the series, this log remains open to new additions. Other volumes are listed below:



* [[[log-of-anomalous-items|]]]

* [[[log-of-anomalous-items-vol-ii|]]]

* [[[log-of-anomalous-items-vol-iii|]]]

* [[[log-of-anomalous-items-vol-iv|]]]

* [[[log-of-anomalous-items-vol-v|]]]

* [[[log-of-anomalous-items-vol-vi|]]]

* **Log Of Anomalous Items, Vol VII**



Lists of [[[log-of-extranormal-events| Extranormal Events]]] and [[[log-of-unexplained-locations| Unexplained Locations]]] have also been compiled. 

----

[[f>toc]]

//**Note:** Please add new entries to the bottom of the list, not the middle or the top.//

[!-- Common formatting:

**Item Description:**

**Date of Recovery:**

**Location of Recovery:**

**Current Status:** --]	 



[!-- After every 10 entries, add 

+++ Anomalous Items XXX1 - XXX0 --]



+++ Anomalous Items 1501 - 1510 



**Item Description:** Gold and ruby armband in the shape of a coiled serpent, reminiscent of ancient Minoan design.  Age of the item is uncertain.  When worn by a human subject, the item will vocalize in what witnesses describe as "what it'd sound like if snakes had a language."  This typically happens only when the wearer is alone, happening far more rarely (<10% of reported instances) with a small group (<5 others).  The item has never vocalized when more than 5 people are present, although how it is aware of this is not known.

**Date of Recovery:** 06/06/2025

**Location of Recovery:** Found among the possessions of a collector of antiquities.

**Current Status:** Being evaluated for potential SCP status.



**Item Description:** A pirated DVD copy of 1998 film //The Truman Show.// Once a sentient and sapient subject fully views the entire film, they will become paranoid of their surroundings, believing themselves to be in the circumstances of the main character of the film, Truman Burbank. This typically subsides after 3-4 days of exposure.

**Date of Recovery:** 06/21/2025

**Location of Recovery:** A flea market in Manila.

**Current Status:** In Low-Security anomalous media storage. Subjects which are under the effects of the item are to be held in a Class-E containment cell until effects subside.



**Item Description:** An emergency exit door. Subjects passing through the door will faint immediately, but only when passing through in the opposite of the indicated direction.

**Date of Recovery:** 04/12/1993

**Location of Recovery:** Berlin, Federal Republic of Germany.

**Current Status:** Is kept in a low-level containment locker at Site-77.



**Item Description:** A Halloween plastic skeleton of approximately 1.74 meters of height which is capable of limited autonomous locomotion through unknown means. It has the ability to speak in multiple languages through a voice box located in its head and will attempt to interact with any individual in the vicinity, becoming inert when alone. All subjects that interact with the anomaly will claim to have had an intricate conversation about the meaning of life or the fear of death and will express a deep gratitude towards the anomaly for its kind words. Audio recordings have revealed that the words said by the anomaly follow nonsensical patterns but adapt to the subject's preferred language.

**Date of Recovery:** 10/20/2010

**Location of Recovery:** A dollar store in Orlando, Florida.

**Current Status:** Kept in Site-99's relaxation room.



**Item Description:** A small badge made to be pinned to a garment, visually similar to children's toy police badges. The pin is made of aluminium and the badge itself is made of slightly oxidized brass. When worn in the intended fashion by a human subject, the subject's preferred name will manifest on the front, through unknown means.

**Date of Recovery:** January 7th, 2017

**Location of Recovery:** In the lost and found box of a restaurant in San Diego, California.

**Current Status:** In low-value item storage.



**Item Description:** Small book, similar in size to a pocket diary, bound in blue imitation leather.  Approximately 60% of the pages are covered in writing in an unknown script.  Examination of the script is difficult at best, as the words move wildly around the pages whenever any attempt is made. Photography of the pages is difficult but possible. Examination using this method has led Foundation linguists to suggest that the script is most likely pictographic in nature; unfortunately, no progress toward identification has been made.

**Date of Recovery:** May 5th, 2025

**Location of Recovery:** Found in a hotel room in Seattle, Washington

**Current Status:** Being examined by experts in obscure languages, in hopes of identifying the writing.

**Note:** The previous occupant of the room in question before the discovery of this item claims to have no knowledge of it and insists they had never seen it before.



**Item Description:** A double sided 10 inch, 45 RPM vinyl record in a nondescript paper sleeve. The circular dark blue label on the record sports the text ‘50/50’ in cursive script in gold, accompanied by a RCA Victor logo. Side B is comprised entirely of a monotone 2600hz beep. When played on Side A, an unknown voice with Transatlantic accent openly challenges the users listening to figure out the opening hooks of songs with similar characteristics. This challenge includes a 20 second ‘guessing’ period for listeners to discuss and cast their final decision via a group vote. Depending on the voting outcome, the voice praises or drily chastises the listeners afterwards while the muted song plays out in full. Songs are seemingly randomly chosen with each playback. Documented examples included //Somebody I Used to Know// by Gotye and //Anxiety// by Doiechii as well as //Under Pressure// by Queen and //Ice Ice Baby// by Vanilla Ice. 

**Date of Recovery:** 5/18/2025 

**Location of Recovery:** Auxiliary Storage Site-384, where it arrived at the administrative office in a USPS media mailer with no return address. 

**Current Status:** Held in low-risk media storage at Site-384. 



**Item Description**: A 18x16x9 mm wood chip made of southern red oak. When moved by a human through direct skin contact, the wood chip will move with zero resistance and remain in the exact spot it was left, regardless of if it is being supported or not. The fragment has demonstrated immunity to gravity, winds, flowing water, and attempts at displacement from other living creatures such as ants, dogs, small spiders, and on one occasion, [[[SCP-615]]].

**Date of Recovery:** 6/19/1995

**Location of Recovery:** Found hovering roughly 2 meters off the ground in a Tennessee shopping mall. Investigative attempts to discover how long it had been there have returned inconclusive results. Civilians demonstrated minimal interest.

**Current Status:** Being used as a "fidget toy" in the psychiatric ward of Site-38.



**Item Description**: A wood chessboard on which the g5 tile is entirely circular, rather than square, without interrupting the tessellated checker pattern. Attempts to replicate this geometric anomaly, even through photographs, have been unsuccessful, as in photographs the chessboard appears as one solid color with no checkered pattern at all.

**Date of Recovery:** 12/26/2015

**Location of Recovery:** The home of Dr. █████ █████. Item was received as a Christmas gift.

**Current Status:** Kept alongside a non-anomalous chess set in Site-17's third-floor break room.



**Item Description:** A pair of reading glasses with blue plastic frames.  When used by a human subject, the subject sees any and all text in their native language.  Anomalous languages are unaffected.

**Date of Recovery:** July 8th, 2025

**Location of Recovery:** In the lost and found box at [REDACTED] High, Montgomery, AL

**Current Status:** Available for use by Foundation linguists.



+++ Anomalous Items 1511 - 1520 



**Item Description:** A blue stoneware bowl 13.7 centimeters in diameter and 4.76 centimeters in height. Regardless of the environment it occupies, the bowl will slowly fill with lukewarm water over the course of a month (the filling process has notably sped up during February). Regardless of how messy the bowl may be or how hazardous the surrounding area is, the water generated will be potable unless removed and additionally contaminated.

**Date of Recovery:**  5/26/2011

**Location of Recovery:**  The house of Site-101's Dr. Byrne, who had been deceased for 2 months at the time of investigation.

**Current Status:** Being used as a planter in Site-101. Precautions have been taken due to the fragile medium of the object.



**Item Description:** An oil painting depicting a common white-tailed deer in a forest setting.  Anyone viewing the object for longer than 15 seconds displays increasing paranoia, complaining of being watched and/or hunted.  The effect stops increasing when line of sight to the painting is broken, which typically occurs naturally as subjects attempt to find the hidden watchers.  The effect fades over the course of a few minutes.

**Item Description:** A vinyl record of the song “Shout!” by The Isley Brothers with a minor scratch on its B-side. When the B-side is played on any device capable of playing vinyl records, the record will begin to skip at approximately the 85 second mark, at which point the lyrics[[footnote]] “A little bit louder now (Shout!)”[[/footnote]] will repeat and volume of the song will increase exponentially until the record is removed from the player or the player is turned off. As of writing, the loudest sound produced was approximately 157db.

**Date of Recovery:** August 21st, 20██

**Location of Recovery:** Found in the rubble of the home of Mr. ██████, Cincinnati, OH.

**Current Status:** Stored in a standard containment locker in Site-19's Safe Containment wing. SCP classification pending.



**Item Description:** A ceramic sculpture of a "Garden Gnome," with a large white beard wearing a blue tunic, olive green pants, black boots, and a red cap. The gnome is depicted standing with its hands at its side, and a mournful expression. Analysis has revealed a complete and active human nervous, respiratory, digestive, renal, and circulatory system within the sculpture. Electroencephalograms matched patterns consistent with those of humans experiencing excruciating pain.

**Date of Recovery:** May 1st, 2003

**Location of Recovery:** A ███████ ██ located within ██████, West Virginia

**Current Status:** --Located at Site-██'s Staff Recreation Room-- Decommissioned per Ethics Committee mandate on March 23rd, 2026

**Note:** Several other (currently undocumented) anomalous items were seized and decommissioned on March 23rd, 2026 following an unannounced examination of Site-██.



**Item Description:** A 4.0oz tube of █████™ sour ooze candy, labelled as being blue raspberry flavored. When the contents of the tube come into contact with human saliva, the consumer's skin pigmentation will rapidly adopt a dark blue color[[footnote]] Described as "Navy Blue" by ███████ ███████ during recovery following a call to 911. [[/footnote]] over approximately 1.25 seconds following consumption. Treatment for affected individuals is currently limited to cosmetic surgery, as there are (as of March 23rd, 2026) no known ways to reverse the changes to the skin's pigmentation.

**Date of Recovery:** September 8th, 2025

**Location of Recovery:** ███████ Family Residence, ███████, North Carolina.

**Current Status:** Stored within Site-██ low-risk storage.



**Item Description:** Blue cotton vest, similar to those marketed for fishing purposes, with several pockets.  When worn by a human subject, and the subject begins to pat the pockets in an attempt to find a specific item, a small but useful item will be found in one of the pockets. Any object produced in this way is not necessarily what the subject wanted at the moment, but is typically useful in the current situation. Objects produced are non-anomalous and can be used as normal.  When not used in this fashion, the pockets contain only what was left in them most recently (which should be nothing, outside of testing situations).

**Date of Recovery:** June 8th, 2026

**Location of Recovery:** Discovered in the lost and found box at a public park in [REDACTED], following online rumors of a magical fishing vest.

**Current Status:** Being tested; proposals for testing with potential Anomalous Items or SCP-level objects is under review.



**Item Description:** A paperback scientific work of literature containing 1120 pages, labelled on the front cover as "The Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Normalities Fifth Edition," abbreviated to "DSMN-5" in the subtitle. Anomalous effects manifest when the book is read by a conscious individual literate in the English language whom has been diagnosed with any mental disorder described in the non-anomalous DSM-5[[footnote]]The Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, Fifth Edition[[/footnote]]. Upon the last utterance of a paragraph's contents describing the subject's mental affliction, they will find the effects of their disorder no longer active. Extended evaluations and observation conducted by foundation psychiatrists and therapists have revealed that this "cure" is ineffective, with an extended tendency for self harm and suicidal behavior observed among patients within as little as 30 days after exposure.

**Date of Recovery:** June 10th, 2017

**Location of Recovery:** Office B7, The Waites-Bathory Insitute for the Mentally Disturbed, Massachusetts, United States of America.

**Current Status:** --In possession of Site-██'s senior psychiatrist, Dr. Wittenberg-- Transferred to low-risk storage following the events of March 23rd, 2026.



**Item Description:** Transparent plastic rain cape.  No information regarding the manufacturer is visible as the tag has been removed. When worn by a human subject during a period of rain, the wearer of the cape becomes unable to be consciously noticed by others unless his or her presence is pointed out, but others will unconsciously avoid running into the individual. Any actions taken by the subject in question are explained as mere coincidence.

**Date of Recovery:** June 17th, 2026

**Location of Recovery:** In a lost and found bin at [REDACTED] High School, Providence, RI

**Current Status:** Undergoing testing.



**Item Description:** A wooden shepherd's crook measuring 1.55 meters, with its hook able to broaden and shrink when in contact with a sentient subject. When an individual or animal is ensnared either by the neck or leg via the hook, they become unable to escape until released by the handler.

**Date of Recovery:** 6/4/2026

**Location of Recovery:** County Clare, Ireland.

**Current Status:** Stored within a standard containment locker.



**Item Description:** A dagger from the Mycenaean era of Greece. Skin contact with its blade causes temporary paralysis in human beings.[[footnote]]Injury with the blade is not necessary for paralysis to take effect.[[/footnote]]

**Date of Recovery:** February 3rd, 1884

**Location of Recovery:** Lyon, France. Traded to the Estate Noir[[footnote]]French precursor organization.[[/footnote]] by the private collector [[[marshall-carter-and-dark-hub | Percival Darke]]] as part of a larger exchange.

**Current Status:** Held in Site-17's anomalous item storage vault.



+++ Anomalous Items 1611 - 1620



**Item Description:** A domestic cow with a pale yellow hide and a keratinous growth on its head resembling a Santa hat. Instead of milk, object produces eggnog from its udders.

**Date of Recovery:** December 8th, 2008

**Location of Recovery:** A field in Kentucky, first sighted by a local hiker.

**Current Status:** Held in a low security containment cell at Site-19



**Item Description:** An ongoing phenomena surrounding the account "ShadowFan52" on the website "ROMHackBus.org", an internet forum. The account documents an elaborate personal life and regularly interacts with other users, however there is no other evidence of the individual existing. Research indicates that the activity of the account is created by a chain of highly unlikely events[[footnote]] Including power surges, bit-flips from solar rays and one instance of an anomalous cyber-criminal trying to use an infohazard to shut off large portions of the internet that was stopped by the Foundation. [[/footnote]] that not only happen at abnormal frequency but consistently cause data corruption that manifests as coherent posts the software can render. This occurs regardless of where the server for "ROMHackBus.org" is stored.

**Date of Recovery:** June 2nd, 2004.

**Location of Recovery:** A server farm in California.

**Current Status:** "ROMHackBus.org" at the time of writing only has fifteen remaining non-anomalous users, and the owner of the platform has expressed losing interest in continuing to operate and pay for the website. Site-15 has assembled protocols to continue to host to preserve the anomaly and use Foundation staff to interact with the account so it does not experience mental deterioration from isolation, assuming that there is an actual intelligence responsible for the activity and it is not simply random chance.



**Item Description:** A yellow padlock, which makes any human subject that makes physical contact with it believe that the Sun will explode in the following 10 seconds. Anomalous effects disappear after subject realizes the Sun didn't explode. 

**Date of Recovery:** March 12th, 2025

**Location of Recovery:** ███████ Gym, Kalasin, Kalasin province, Thailand 

**Current Status:** In storage 



**Item Description:** A 6 made of white plastic. Despite lacking any identifiable marks, any subject exposed to it will correctly identify it as a 6 instead of a 9 even when presented upside down. 

**Date of Recovery:** October 7th, 1995

**Location of Recovery:** ███████ School, Independència, Guairá Department, Paraguay.

**Current Status:** In storage. 



**Item Description:** A standard, unbranded cardboard tissue box that contains an infinite supply of non-anomalous wood-pulp tissues. X-ray scans of the interior show a distorted spatial region. 

**Date of Recovery:** ██/██/20██

**Location of Recovery:**An aged care facility in Oregon.

**Current Status:** Kept tethered in the Staff Breakroom at Site-██. 



**Item Description:** A wooden door painted pink. Following its opening, a male instance of //Velociraptor mongoliensis// will manifest on the other side of the door before vocalizing in English, "Do you mind? We're very busy," closing the door and demanifesting. Attempts to stop this set of events have consistently failed. 

**Date of Recovery:** June 12th, 1993 

**Location of Recovery:** Middle of a steppe in Southern Mongolia.

**Current Status:** In possession of the Department of Paleontology for research purposes.



**Item Description:** A worn mahogany bureau that is consistent with early 19th century manufacture. When an individual attempts to write on a piece of paper while at the bureau, a vocalization near the individual will offer advice for any subject matter the individual is currently thinking. Writing via digital devices yields no anomalous effects.

**Date of Recovery:** 20/06/1937

**Location of Recovery:** An antiques shop in London, UK.

**Current Status:** Kept in low-value storage.



**Item Description:** A 15 inch tall statuette of a traveling salesman holding two briefcases, with attire consistent with the late 1940s. When viewed by a group of individuals, regardless of whether or not an auction is currently being held, each viewer feels a strong compulsion to place a bid on the item. Subsequent bids increase the price by ██%, and continue until all parties involved can no longer afford to bid. Viewing the item alone or with no currency present results in anomalous effects not manifesting.

**Date of Recovery:** February 10th, 1999

**Location of Recovery:** A Marshall, Carter, & Dark auction held at ████ ████, China. Before recovery by MTF Mu-3, the item's final price reached approximately ¥██,███,███.██ over its original value of ¥2,030.

**Current Status:** In storage. A sign is posted near the item's containment locker prohibiting any form of currency in the area. 



**Item Description:** A glass marble, visually identical to commercially available varieties. Appears non-anomalous until viewed by a human subject, at which point the subject will become convinced that the item is capable of moving on its own, and has done so when the item was unobserved. Pointing out that the item is still in its original position will have no effect, as this will be rationalized. This effect is relatively weak and fades quickly.

**Date of Recovery:** July 14th, 2026

**Location of Recovery:** A thrift store in Maryland

**Current Status:** In low-value item storage.



**Item Description:** --A bronze and iron mechanism that functions as a perpetual motion machine.-- 

**Date of Recovery:** --July 12th, 2026--

**Location of Recovery:** --Basement in Hamamatsu, Japan--

**Current status:** --In storage-- 

**Notes:** //Due to the great number of perpetual motion machines discovered by the SCP Foundation, further additions to this log of this nature will be rejected.// — Lead Researcher John A. Squires. 



+++ Anomalous Items 1621 - 1630



**Item Description:** An octagonal green street sign labeled "GO" which exhibited cognitohazardous effects on drivers

**Date of Recovery:** July 24th, 2026

**Location of Recovery:** Intersection of Shadowwood Dr. and Maple Valley St. in Gun Barrel City, TX.

**Current status:** In storage

**Notes:** Casualties: 1 dead, 3 injured. Foundation operatives working with law enforcement have explained the two crashes as the result of faulty accelerator pedal installation by a local auto repair shop.



**Item Description:** A preserved human thumb wrapped in ancient linen cloth. Physical contact with the object causes feelings of hostility toward minorities and foreigners to develop, as well as a sudden surge in patriotism. All effects vanish once the object is released. DNA testing has been inconclusive.

**Date of Recovery:** August 21st, 2008

**Location of Recovery:** Hidden storage space in Poenari Castle, Romania 

**Current Status:** In storage



**Item Description:** An unidentified object that mimics the appearance, but not the function, of the nearest object. Its real form is currently unknown. It constantly emits small quantities of X-rays.

**Date of Recovery:** July 8th, 1947

**Location of Recovery:** Roswell, New Mexico

**Current Status:** Contained in a lead-lined container.

**Notes:** Object currently possesses the appearance of a slightly smaller lead-lined container.



**Item Description:** Two stable, unreactive atoms of flerovium-114, a nuclide consisting entirely of protons

**Date of Recovery:** September 3rd, 1999 

**Location of Recovery:** Dubna, Russia

**Current Status:** Contained in an ion trap.

**Notes:** As of August 9th, 2026, all attempts to repeat synthesis have failed.



**Item Description:** An Arcadia-brand arcade cabinet of the game ████████. The interior is comprised of a full set of human organs, which are wired to various mechanical components such as the control panel and monitor. Individuals who make physical contact express the sensation of arms wrapping around them after four minutes, followed by the subject being anomalously consumed shortly after.

**Date of Recovery:** February 29th, 2016

**Location of Recovery:** A warehouse in Boston, Massachusetts

**Current Status:** Kept in low-risk item storage. A sign is posted near the item's containment prohibiting any physical contact.



**Item Description:** A crude rocket launcher comprised of various components from household appliances, including mismatched pipes, a metallic funnel, and a glass bottle. When loaded with any projectile, regardless of whether or not the loaded object is a rocket or has a rocket motor, the inserted item will be propelled at the rate of ███ meters per second when fired. 

**Date of Recovery:** 27/06/2012

**Location of Recovery:** Recovered after a Chaos Insurgency raid on Site-██

**Current Status:** Being tested.

**Note:** //Despite its amateurish construction, it's surprisingly durable. Throughout all of our tests, it's managed to perfectly fire anything we load into it, from rockets to miscellaneous items like tennis balls. Further testing is needed to determine how large of an object we can use.//  - Researcher Doe



**Item Description:** A shape that always has an N-number of sides, corners, and vertices.[[footnote]]N = Natural numbers.[[/footnote]]

**Date of Recovery:** 13/08/2002

**Location of Recovery:** Site-43

**Current Status:** Currently within Mathematical Locker 18 of S43.

**Note:** Attempted interaction of the object by persons within S43 had unpredictable results.



**Item Description:** A string of 96 numbers that, when entered into an applicable elevator via the buttons to select a floor, will cause the elevator to arrive in an alternate timeline which has no noted deviation from the baseline besides the string discovered in the other universe being a different series of numbers. This string has the reverse effect; allowing individuals from the other timeline to enter the baseline. Neither string has any impact outside of the timeline it was discovered in.

**Date of Recovery:** July 6th, 1972

**Location of Recovery:** On a post-it note attached to the outer doors of the Site-██ C-Wing elevator.

**Current Status:** Written on a post-it note in Dr. Jacob's office and the duplicate of his office in the other timeline.

//How in God's name did anybody figure this out? Does anybody have access to the recovery log?// - Specialist Daniels



**Item Description:** A miniature diorama depicting the initial containment of SCP-████ by Foundation operatives, with glass enclosing the model. Every half hour, the model figures inside begin to replicate the exact movements and outcome of the encounter with SCP-████, with only minor deviations every loop. Any damage to the model figures caused during the battle is repaired after the scene finishes, before they return to their original positions shortly after.

**Date of Recovery:** June 15th, 2015

**Location of Recovery:** A museum in Stockholm, Sweden.

**Current Status:** On display in Dr. ███████'s office.



**Item Description:** A film reel of the 1952 social guidance film //Duck and Cover//. When an individual over the age of five observes the film to its conclusion, they begin to feel an intense sense of dread regarding nuclear war, leading to a strong compulsion to hide underneath the nearest piece of furniture. This effect typically persists for a period of ten minutes, but can subside earlier if the individual is presented evidence that no nuclear detonation has occurred.

**Date of Recovery:** September 15th, 2004

**Location of Recovery:** Inside a container of non-anomalous film reels sold during an auction in Washington, D.C.

**Current Status:** Kept within low-risk media storage at Site-███.



+++ Anomalous Items 1631 - 1640



**Item Description:** Wooden door, painted white.  Any time a human subject knocks on the door, an unidentified female voice from the other side says "I'll be out in a minute!"  This occurs regardless of whether the door is installed in a doorway, whether anyone is on the other side, or who knocks on the door.

**Date of Recovery:** September 9th, 2026

**Location of Recovery:** A hardware store in Cincinnati, OH

**Current Status:** In storage.

**Note:** //The Foundation is currently attempting to identify the voice associated with this item.  It does not appear to respond when spoken to, although whether it is unable to do so or simply refusing to is unclear.  Researchers assigned to the project say it's "slow going".// - Researcher Malkin

**Additional Note:** //Proposals to knock on both sides of the door simultaneously have been and will continue to be rejected.  Interesting as it would be to find out what would happen, the risk of paradox should not be ignored.// - Dr. ██████████



**Item Description:** One hammer and one falcon feather. When both objects are dropped simultaneously by the same subject, the hammer will fall anomalously slowly and the feather anomalously quickly. Tests in vacuum environments have failed to produce any anomalous effects. 

**Date of Recovery:** July 21st, 1971

**Location of Recovery:** John F. Kennedy Space Center, Merritt Island, Florida

**Current Status:** In storage.



**Item Description:** A drawing of a map that disproves the Four Color Theorem.[[footnote]]A theorem that states that no more than four colors are required to color the regions of any map so that no two adjacent regions have the same color.[[/footnote]]

**Date of Recovery:** June 22nd, 1976

**Location of Recovery:** Crumbled in a wastebasket in the University of Illinois 

**Current Status:** Under study by the Department of Anomalous Topology. 

**Note:** //I've spent the last three hours staring at this drawing, and I still can't find out where it should fail.// - Dr. Cuco



**Item Description:** A fridge magnet that, when used to hang any printed map upon a magnetic surface, will cause New Zealand to disappear from the map. The country will reappear once the magnet is taken off.

**Date of Recovery:** May 3rd, 2026

**Location of Recovery:** A high school classroom in ████████, Australia

**Current Status:** In storage. 

**Note:** //Haha, I get it guys, my country doesn't exist. You can stop showing me maps as "proof".// - Dr. Stevenson



**Item Description:** A copper arrowhead that exerts a strong memetic compulsion effect. If a sapient creature views the object, they will attempt to inflict a mild wound on themselves with it, for the stated purpose of "getting a sit." After the subject wounds themselves, all effects cease, and they develop an immunity to the meme.

**Date of Recovery:** September 2, 2026

**Location of Recovery:** The apartment of one Robert Poleman, Agent Sadie Poleman's younger brother.

**Current Status:** Stored in an opaque tube in Site-19's Safe Containment wing. Available for research by Memetics Department personnel upon request.



**Item Description:** A lithium-ion battery that sustains a voltage of exactly 7.0375821 volts. It never runs out or changes voltage.

**Date of Recovery:** September 21, 2026

**Location of Recovery:** The battery inside of a remote control of one Jason Liu, a civilian with no known connections to the foundation.

**Current Status:** In storage.



**Item Description:** 1/2 liter plastic bottle, reminiscent of disposable drink bottles, with remnants of glue and paper indicating that a label was once present but was removed before containment. When the bottle's cap is firmly screwed on and the item is touched by a human subject, liquid of some kind will manifest within the bottle. This is typically a soft drink of some variety, although other liquids have been reported. Liquids produced are rarely (>10% of cases) something the subject would have chosen, but are palatable enough to be consumed regardless.

**Date of Recovery:** September 20th, 2026

**Location of Recovery:** Abandoned at Wrigley Field, Chicago, IL

**Current Status:** Being tested.



**Item Description:** Small hand mirror, no manufacturer's information visible.  When used by a human subject, the subject will see some variety of small, harmless animal sitting on their body.  No notable pattern has been discovered, and the animal changes between uses.  The animal only appears in the mirror, although some subjects have reported feeling pressure or weight in the relevant area.

**Date of Recovery:** September 21st, 2026

**Location of Recovery:** [REDACTED] Middle School, Greer, AL

**Current Status:** In storage.



**Item Description:** Full-sized memory foam mattress.  When placed in an appropriate bed frame and used by a human subject, the subject suffers a cognitohazardous effect causing them to believe some variety of monster is under the bed.  Subjects are either unable or unwilling to describe what form this creature takes, but typically experience significant fear, rendering them unable to fall asleep.

**Date of Recovery:** September 19th, 2026

**Location of Recovery:** In the contents of an abandoned storage locker, belonging to an individual with suspected ties to Group of Interest Are We Cool Yet?

**Current Status:** In storage.



**Item Description:** Sword made in the style of early 3rd-century BCE Greek weapons. Item displays mild wear and tear, but nothing to indicate it was as old as the design suggests. Analysis of the material indicates that the item cannot have been made earlier than 1980, and with modern techniques. When touched by a human subject, the subject is filled with an unreasoning hatred of Athens and anything related to it. This effect fades very quickly when the object is released.

**Date of Recovery:** September 20th, 2026

**Location of Recovery:** Abandoned at a convention center in Rochester, NY

**Current Status:** Being tested.



+++ Anomalous Items 1641 - 1650



**Item Description:** A common sunflower (Helianthus annuus), with the disk florets being replaced by a sustained fusion reaction. The reaction radiates no heat and produces minimal light. Every 24 hours a large ember will launch from the object.

**Date of Recovery:** 5/5/2009

**Location of Recovery:** Office in Seattle, Washington

**Current Status:** Break room of Bio Site-7.



**Item Description:** An Iveco Daily van fitted with a specialised insulated refrigerated box body, formerly owned and branded by Tesco plc. During use to make food deliveries, all items in the van are replaced with similar, yet distinctly different, items. During delivery, the customers are informed via automatic email that their items have been replaced.

**Date of Recovery:** October 1st, 2019

**Location of Recovery:** Tesco Superstore, Southampton, Hampshire

**Current Status:** Kept for delivery usage in Foundation supply chains.



**Item Description**: 4 dirty sheets of paper, each measuring 21 by 14 centimetres, lightly ripped on the side, theorised to have been ripped out from a journal. --On one of the pages is written with permanent marker "Don't forget about me." the rest were found blank-- Each page appears blank, anything written or drawn on the pages, disappears as soon as the writer dies, any attempt to write or draw on the pages indirectly, fails to leave a mark on the pages regardless of method. --Aside from these properties the papers have no notable anomalous traits.-- At undetermined intervals the phrase "Don't forget about me." appears written on one of the pages, of the two times this phenomenon was recorded, they lasted 3.7 seconds and 1.8 seconds, respectively. There are no other notable phenomenon present during this.

**Date of Recovery**: November 8rd, 1984

**Location of Recovery**: Discovered in Police evidence in Greenwood, Delaware.

**Current Status**: In storage.



**Item Description:** Paperback copy of //The Catcher in the Rye// by J.D. Salinger. Subjects who read past the third chapter develop an anomalous compulsion to kill English musician John Lennon and will prioritize doing so. The compulsion ends when the subject hears or sees a statement that John Lennon is already deceased.

**Date of Recovery:** December 3rd, 2012

**Location of Recovery:** In a bookstore in Brisbane, Australia.

**Current Status:** In storage.

**Note:** The book is not the same copy that was in possession of Mark David Chapman.

log-vanguard-licensing-rejections.raw_content:
Hello! If you're reading this, then we welcome you to Vanguard's Legal & Licensing department!

Ever since we revealed ourselves to the public, Vanguard has received a lot of requests to license, document, and/or artistically depict material under our organization's umbrella, from the VNPs we have on file to our past as the SCP Foundation.

However, just because our organization is public doesn't mean anything about us is free for anyone to use. All documentation and information is released under a Vanguard Public License, which means they are free to view and reproduce, but derivative for-profit works must follow Vanguard guidelines.

The three guidelines are as follows:

  1. The information must only be presented in non-fictional and educational contexts, such as history books, biographies, and documentaries.
  2. Coverage of sapient living individuals requires the consent of all parties involved. Coverage of deceased individuals is exempt, except for cases in which they are represented by an estate or next-of-kin.
  3. The media must not present the information in misleading or false/untrue lights.

These guidelines are non-negotiable and unwavering.

Now, due to some incidents caused by prior members of VL&L, let me list what the guidelines are not for:

  • Stifling of public discussion about Vanguard and/or its past
  • Pursuing creatives (professional or amateur) who do not sell their works for profit
  • Libel and/or slander litigations against comedians, meme creators, internet posts, etc.

We are not against people making fun of us or our past, being uninformed, or creating art. We simply do not wish for people to maliciously spread misinformation about Vanguard and our predecessor organization.

Anyway, this page is meant as documentation of licensing proposals that we have rejected in one way or another. This information is not applicable with the Vanguard Public License, and remains confidential to Vanguard Legal & Licensing. Dissemination of the contents of these pages is subject to disciplinary action.

If you have any further questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to me at gro.draugnav.lagel|ztakpp#gro.draugnav.lagel|ztakpp.

Penny Katz, Head of Vanguard's Legal and Licensing department




+ Out-of-universe guidelines for adding to this page
- Close guidelines

Please follow this format when adding new entries to this list:

Rejection Case #: (three strings of 5 alphanumeric characters, separated by dashes)
Name of Licensee: (insert name here)
Requested Vanguard Material: (insert VNP or other Vanguard/SCPF-related material here)
Type of Media: (Insert media type here)
Intent: (Insert licensees' intentions for the material here)
Rejection Reason: (Violation of Guideline 1/2/3 and/or Other (Specify))
Notes: (If applicable; this is where you can be a little snarky, if you want C: )

Use this code to add to the list:

[[div class="blockquote"]]
**Rejection Case #:** 
**Name of Licensee:** 
**Requested Vanguard Material:** 
**Type of Media:** 
**Intent:**
**Rejection Reason:** 
**Notes:** 
[[/div]]

Please post new entries chronologically. Do not do format screws or anything that'd give the Licensing Team headaches.

AlienSpaceBat will prune anything that doesn't fit the spirit of this page, and will provide reasoning in the discussion page.

Have fun!

Rejection Case #: SXJXO-KZLDP-J9TQM
Name of Licensee: The Walt Disney Company and Hearst Communications, via ESPN, Inc.
Requested Vanguard Material: VNP-1733
Type of Media: Documentary
Intent: Documenting the history of VNP-1733, as well as reactions by members of the Boston Celtics, Miami Heat, and the public to the actions recorded and depicted within.
Rejection Reason: Violation of Guideline 3 (Companies expressed desire of editorializing and sanitizing VNP-1733's contents and reactions towards it).

Rejection Case #: VLBVK-5N7AP-RR3H8
Name of Licensee: HBO
Requested Vanguard Material: Documentation regarding Lighthouse-17 and the actions it undertook under the Foundation
Type of Media: Four-part docudrama miniseries
Intent: Detailing the history of the former Site-17, with reenactments of key moments
Rejection Reason: Violation of Guideline 2 (a majority of subjects either rejected or were unable to give consent to being documented), Violation of Guideline 3 (dramatic licensing required would result in whitewashing and/or downplaying of certain elements)

Rejection Case #: HOP2R-EV2PW-2AEZ4
Name of Licensee: Comcast Corporation, Via NBCUniversal, LLC
Requested Vanguard Material: Documentation involving Thomas Yaltz
Type of Media: Multimedia
Intent: Creation of a multimedia universe based off of Mr. Yaltz's life and experiences, comprised of movies, television shows, animation, games, toys, etc.
Rejection Reason: Violation of Guideline 1 (e.g. licensee expressed desire for drastic dramatic licensing for "the sake of entertainment"), Violation of Guideline 2 (Acquiring universal consent from multiversal and extradimensional beings encountered by Mr. Yaltz is deemed to be impossible), Violation of Guideline 3 (e.g. Vanguard and the Foundation would be consistently presented in a comedically incompetent and "stuffy" light)
Notes: Mr. Yaltz was noticeably saddened upon being informed of the rejection, having been in preliminary discussions with NBCUniversal representatives beforehand. A compromise - wherein Mr. Yaltz would be allowed to be a special guest on Saturday Night Live, minus the inclusion of other Vanguard/Foundation material - was reached. - Penny Katz

Rejection Case #: W6NVM-LPPN9-6BTH7
Name of Licensee: Netflix, Inc.
Requested Vanguard Material: Documentation of SCP-1730
Type of Media: Streaming movie
Intent: Creation of a dramatic documentary regarding the discovery and disaster of SCP-1730 with the dual intentions of honoring those deceased and encouraging further public interest in SCP-1730, potentially leading to the recovery of further information regarding the incident.
Rejection Reason: Violation of Guideline 1 (e.g. licensee expressed desire for dramatic reenactment under the stated intention of "encouraging further public interest), Guideline 2 (former MTF Tau-5 Lead Irantu expressed disinterest in the project when informed by the Vanguard)
Notes: They didn't even use the correct terminology in their stated Intent. - Penny Katz

Ever since we revealed ourselves to the public, Vanguard has received a lot of requests to license, document, and/or artistically depict material under our organization's umbrella, from the VNPs we have on file to our past as the SCP Foundation. However, just because our organization is public doesn't mean anything about us is free for anyone to use. All documentation and information is released under a **Vanguard Public License**, which means they are free to view and reproduce, but derivative for-profit works must follow Vanguard guidelines. The three guidelines are as follows: # The information must only be presented in non-fictional and educational contexts, such as history books, biographies, and documentaries. # Coverage of sapient living individuals requires the consent of all parties involved.
